title: Bazaar Shed Open Friday 8/7
summary: Starting this Friday, August 7, the furniture shed at Palm Hill Country Club will be open from 9-11 AM for pick-ups and deliveries. Call Dan Hannafin at 207-731-2299 to schedule.
public_detail: The bazaar vacations are over and we are pleased to announce starting this Friday 8/7 the furniture shed is open 9-11. We are also available for pick-ups and deliveries. Please call or text to schedule, Dan Hannafin 207-731-2299 Dan Hannafin
